description: This file contains React components and utility functions for rendering links, attachments, trace links, and managing URL search parameters within a test report UI. It is specific to the HTML reporter component of Playwright's test framework.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component for rendering a styled clickable link that handles navigation.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component for linking to a specific project within the test report.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component for rendering links to test attachments, with support for expandable content.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component for linking to trace attachments related to test results.

classes.name: SearchParamsContext
classes.description: React context for managing URL search parameters.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Function to programmatically change the browser URL and dispatch a popstate event.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Hook to access current URL search parameters.

methods.name: SearchParamsProvider
methods.description: Component providing search parameters context to children.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook to handle scrolling to an element when it is anchored.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Hook to determine if a given ID is currently anchored in URL.

methods.name: Anchor
methods.description: Component that scrolls into view when its ID is anchored.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Function to generate URL hash for specific test and result, including anchor.
